prompt: A flat layered paper-cut collage in a strict handcraft design system: everything is cut from colored cardstock and hanji paper with perfectly clean cut edges — NO outline of any kind on any piece: no bright edge line, no white edge, no dark contour line. Each object is built from two to five completely flat die-cut pieces layered ON THE OBJECT ITSELF — its own silhouette, a main color piece, one or two detail pieces and a highlight piece — the object is never placed on a base, platform, pedestal, plinth or pile of paper sheets; Every upper piece sits slightly RAISED above the piece beneath it, so along EVERY boundary where two different colors meet, the upper piece casts a soft narrow warm dark-brown shadow down onto the lower piece — a gentle embossed paper relief wherever two colors touch, and this relief shadow is the ONLY depth cue. Cut economy: every scissor cut is purposeful and confident — a shape that is straight in the real object is cut with a clean STRAIGHT edge, and curves appear ONLY where the real object is actually curved. No decorative wavy edges, no bumpy wobbly outlines, no gratuitous scalloping on untextured surfaces; a rectangular block is cut as a plain rectangle, though corners may be gently ROUNDED — softly rounding a corner is natural scissor work. Shapes stay simple and chunky, no detail finer than real scissors could cut. Scalloped repeat patterns for textures like straw or waves, cut big and loose. Strictly straight-on orthographic front view, zero perspective. No volume, no curvature, no folded paper, no sculpting. Real-scissors discipline: every piece is a shape that could actually be cut with scissors from a single sheet of colored paper. EACH PIECE IS EXACTLY ONE SOLID FLAT COLOR — no gradient, no shading, no airbrush, no painted detail inside a piece; every color change is a separate stacked paper piece, even a thin line is its own paper strip. ALL pieces share one identical fine colored-paper texture. All shadows are neutral warm dark-brown paper shadows, never colored. Palette: deep night indigo #1D2459 and #2A3380, cream moon #FFF7E8, sunflower #FFC83D, coral #FF7759, mint #22B07D, lilac #B48CF5, sky #3AA6F5. Magical cosy storybook night. A layered paper-cut diorama scene seen straight-on: built from SIX to EIGHT flat paper layers one behind another, each layer a cut-paper silhouette casting a soft warm shadow on the layer behind, giving strong shadow-box depth. Scene: a luxurious paper-cut night sky backdrop for a children's story theater: a big layered paper crescent moon upper right, many small cut-paper stars of different sizes, soft scalloped paper clouds in lilac and sky blue, three layers of rolling paper hills along the bottom in deep blues and mint, a tiny distant paper village with warm lit windows, a few paper fireflies. The CENTRE and upper-middle stay calm open sky (cards will be placed over it). FULL-BLEED, edge to edge. No text.
